title: register.events
description: A new player, published once when the player registers, on the player events exchange (PAM_EXCHANGE, default pam.events). The envelope's `playerId` must be a positive JSON integer (never quoted, never fractional) equal to `data.id`; JSON Schema cannot express that equality, the consumer checks it and dead-letters a mismatch. Unknown fields anywhere are ignored.

playerId.description: The player the fact is about; equals `data.id`.

affiliateTag.description: The affiliate tag the brand site stored from `?affiliate=`. The company's identity itself, with no prefix, read in any letter case: every tag is looked up among the companies, and one that names no company, null or absence is acknowledged without effect.

affiliateAttribution.description: Free-form attribution keys the brand site stored at sign-up, string values only. `click_id` is passed to the partner's tracker when it matches ^[A-Za-z0-9._~-]{1,128}$; the whole object is kept on the referral. Absent, null or {} when there are none.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, any letter case. Anything that is not two letters is stored as unknown.

createdAt.description: When the player registered: the referral's registration time and the UTC day it counts on.

data.description: The player snapshot; only these fields are read.
